## Method 1: Using For Loop

```{r}
num <- 1:10
for (x in num) {
  print(x)
}
```

## Method 2: Using While loop

```{r}
x <- 1
while (x <= 10) {
  print(x)
  x <- x + 1
}
```

## Method 3: Using cat

```{r}
num <- 1:11
cat(num, sep = "\n")
```

## Method 4: Using print with vector

```{r}
num <- 1:10
print(num)
```
